Ravi M (Finance): Heads-up from reseller CloudPartner — AWS Marketplace invoice for April shows a mismatch vs. our usage reports. They flagged $15,472 in 'meter reconciliation difference'.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Do we have the exact invoice line IDs and partner CSV? Need to reconcile meter->SKU mapping and any billing window overlap.

Elena S (Sales): Partner attached sample lines. They say usage meter 55601 appears under two partner-account mappings during Apr 10-12 due to a partner-account split we didn't propagate to marketplace records. Snippet:
```
inv_line,sku,partner_account,meter_id,usage,charge
AW-30021,sku-embed,PC-100,55601,20000,6120.00
AW-30022,sku-embed,PC-101,55601,20000,6120.00
```
They total $12,240 here; partner's full reconciliation claims $15,472 including rounding/fees.

BillingBot: AWS payout status for CloudPartner (partner_id CP-77): processed for Apr cycle on 2026-04-15T04:00:00Z. Funds already disbursed.

Ravi M (Finance): Since payout processed we need a manual post-settlement credit. Propose: issue $15,472 credit, memo AWS-MP-2026-04-ADJ, require partner acceptance and record in GL as 4205-REV-CR. Priya?

Priya R (Head of Revenue): Approve the credit and one-time remediation. Please include a short amendment: partner acknowledges the correction and agrees not to pursue claims for the same usage window after acceptance.

Liam B (Billing Ops): I'll prepare the credit note and post the adjustment. Because payout is processed, we'll record as payable reduction and issue a partner credit note. GL action: Debit Revenue 4205 / Credit Cash/Bank if we reimburse, or Credit AP-Partner 2202 if we offset future payments. Recommend offset to avoid bank transfer.

Elena S (Sales): Partner prefers offset against next payout. I'll send amendment and confirm acceptance.

BillingBot: Noted. Please tag me when the amendment is uploaded; I'll mark the partner record and queue the offset for next cycle.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Amendment sent at 2026-04-16T09:05Z. Partner accepted and requested offset at 2026-04-16T11:12Z. Posting adjustment to ledger and queuing offset for May payout. Memo AWS-MP-2026-04-ADJ recorded.

Ravi M (Finance): Adjustment posted. Scheduling a short review with Ops to improve partner-account propagation checks during account splits. Closing for finance.

Priya R (Head of Revenue): Thanks team. Please add this case to the monthly marketplace billing review and surface any recurring patterns.
